rationale: Price is sitting near the low of today's range (18.6% position) after a large gap down, with the last five 1-minute candles showing a tight, directionless chop between roughly $1282 and $1290 — no clear momentum or structure to lean on. The broader tape is risk-off (SPY -1.55%, VIXY +4.89%) and ASML gapped down nearly 2% on top of a prior-day sell-off, suggesting continued selling pressure, but the lack of a clean breakdown or bounce setup makes entry risk/reward unfavorable in either direction right now. With only a small daily loss budget remaining relative to ASML's ~$9.50 ATR per 5-minute bar, the position sizing required to manage risk meaningfully would be too small to justify the trade.
